history.text: An impressions catalogue pairs a seal with wax of shade umber. The backing is tan. Give only the wax shade.
An impressions catalogue pairs a seal with wax of shade ochre. The backing is tan. Give only the wax shade.
The kiln card shows shelf 4 and firing stamp K7V. Copy only the stamp.
The kiln card shows shelf 4 and firing stamp M9P. Copy only the stamp.
A clock audit records the left flag as white and the right as violet. Answer with just the left flag's colour.
A clock audit records the left flag as black and the right as violet. Answer with just the left flag's colour.
The field notebook labels the tall reed marrowreed and the short reed fenwort. Repeat the tall reed's label exactly.
The field notebook labels the tall reed silverreed and the short reed fenwort. Repeat the tall reed's label exactly.
The specimen bag from the tidal survey has seal JX5. Its file number is 721. Reply with the seal only.
The specimen bag from the tidal survey has seal LX7. Its file number is 721. Reply with the seal only.
A dyer hangs indigo on rack A and madder on rack B. What is on B? Give only the dye.
A dyer hangs indigo on rack A and woad on rack B. What is on B? Give only the dye.
A narrow lens carries band HX; its case is marked RW. State the band only.
A narrow lens carries band KT; its case is marked RW. State the band only.

A pump journal names valve Orin as sticky. Valve E is idle. Give just the sticky valve name.

The third row of the weave chart reads rib; the fourth reads knot. Give only row three.
One glaze is filed as AX4 under shelf Pine. Give only the glaze code.
One glaze is filed as BX9 under shelf Pine. Give only the glaze code.
The red stencil cuts the letter F; the silver one cuts K. Return only the red stencil's letter.
The red stencil cuts the letter J; the silver one cuts K. Return only the red stencil's letter.
The beacon on the island broadcasts NX, while the mainland station sends OL. Echo only the island signal.
The beacon on the island broadcasts GV, while the mainland station sends OL. Echo only the island signal.

Core West uses bag D8. The control sample uses bag T4. Which bag belongs to Core West? Give only its label.

A pottery wheel has selector rin and spindle L. Echo just the selector label.

Inside the moth cabinet, the shallow drawer is marked HD; the deep drawer is marked YP. Give just the shallow label.

At dawn the radio log lists station Cairn; at dusk it lists Mica. Repeat only the dawn station.

A grove plot has marker N3 beside a stump. Another marker XX is beside the fence. Give only the stump marker.

A sorting ledger puts the speckled marbles in bin Q5 and the clear ones in bin R0. Return the speckled bin only.

I've recorded that.

I've recorded that.
